hypothesis_status: OVERTURNED. The symptom stands exactly as filed, but neither the need's leads nor the refuter's pinned locus is the cause. (1) The refuter's one-line read was answered NO: ActionFuncLink::func_link_input DOES carry upstream's `!inputlocked || varargs` half (coreaction_protos.rs:654), so active-input recovery does run for a locked variadic. (2) The defect is not in the variadic path at all. It is in P6's local-alias gather: AliasChecker::gatherAdditiveBase treats every non-additive use of a stack-pointer-derived Varnode as a pointer escape, and MSVC's /GS prologue mixes the raw stack pointer into the frame cookie with `xor rax,rsp`. That records an escape site at the BOTTOM of the frame, hasLocalAlias then answers yes for every stack location in the function, and checkInputTrialUse scores EVERY stack-passed argument trial no-use. Instrumented on the witness, the trial at stack:0x28 (= [RSP+0x20]) is registered, characterized ContainsJustified and reaches the scorer with alias=true, outside=false, calleepop=false -- the alias veto and nothing else. The variadic case is only where it is VISIBLE: a locked prototype's NAMED parameters are materialized directly by func_link_input (op_stack_load), bypassing trial scoring entirely, which is exactly why the refuter's five-fixed-parameter A/B recovered the argument. The same defect drops stack-passed arguments at every call site in every /GS function; the whole-binary sweep shows it on ordinary non-variadic calls too (__stdio_common_vfprintf losing its va_list).
decisions: Named `cookiescramble`, P6/alias-facets, default ON: it restores what the ABI actually means rather than adding a judgment call, so it is the callsitestackargs shape -- an ablation handle, not a preference.

The rule is NOT conditioned on the XOR's second operand. A first cut exempted only `ptr ^ non-constant` on the theory that `ptr ^ const` is tagged-pointer arithmetic; the synthesized witness immediately falsified it (a cookie folded to an immediate is the same construct), and a rule that flips on an optimizer detail answers the wrong question.

SCOPED TO THE CALL-SITE CHECKER ONLY. The first implementation changed gather_additive_base for every AliasChecker, including MapState's local-layout gather. Measured on the witness binary that was 17/159 functions changed and Stack<hex> unnamed-address references going 5 -> 38, because dropping the escape site also drops the fake covering array ScopeLocal builds at the alias offset (on this binary a char[32] that overlapped the canary slot). Narrowing the exemption to Funcdata::alias_gather_access -- the checker ActionActiveParam builds -- leaves stack-variable layout byte-identical and cuts the same binary to 6/159 with Stack<hex> unchanged at 3 -> 3. The broader flip is a real second opportunity and is deliberately NOT taken here.

sweep.note: decompile-all on both arms over the RE-dataset images that finished inside the sweep budget. Every changed function grew a call's argument list; no call lost an argument, no callee disappeared, no goto appeared. sub_140002530's loop mix moved 4 while -> 4 for (same 42 loops).
